The unsafe-repair gate is still decided against the evidence Run native ClosedWorldV2 and still refuses. It may still be an ADDITIONAL required condition alongside an already-established native basis, which the sibling case preview-imported-requirement-is-a-supported-requirement-relation shows.

The other half, so the invariant above is not read as removing support: an imported requirement is a lawful repair evidence requirement and, where the NATIVE closed-world gate is independently established, the plan is applicable. Neither imported relation is removed by this correction.

An unsatisfied IMPORTED requirement reaches the public unmet precondition with its own plane and its own cause, so a consumer can tell an unmapped-only import from a native resolution gap. Under the former D9 typing neither was expressible here.
